description: The QFX10000 series of fixed and modular data center spine/core Ethernet switches deliver industry-leading scale, flexibility and openness providing seamless transition from 10GbE and 40GbE interface speeds to 100GbE. Based on our custom Q5 ASICs, these high-performance switches scale from 3 to 96 Tbps of throughput.
